Common questions

Where can LED video walls be installed?

Indoors in places such as homes, showrooms, offices, reception areas and event halls, and outdoors on building fronts, shopfronts and open venues.

Do you provide installation and service?

Yes. Our team handles site visit, installation, setup and testing, and we provide service and repair afterwards.

Can the size and shape be planned for my space?

We plan the size and layout around your space and requirement. Call or message us to discuss what you have in mind.

Which type of display is right for me?

It depends on where it will be used and what you want to show. Tell us about your space and we will suggest the best option.

How do I get a quote?

Use the WhatsApp buttons on this page or call us. Tell us whether it is for indoors or outdoors and roughly where it will go.
